notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Thunderbolt
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c9b5a5df452797f41228f81125bacf586dc73b65.gif
Zero Hour's Operation Thunderbolt is here with exciting additions and significant optimizations that will enhance your gaming experience. Prepare to trudge through a new map, engage with an AI squad, and wield the game's first non-lethal weapon. We've also fine-tuned shooting mechanics, improved door interactions, and enhanced audio functionality for smoother and more immersive gameplay. 
[hr][/hr]
Main Features:  

New Map: Show Time 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e75ae4207284a7b3d186ebfcfd3e05269ac5509a.jpg

In a stunning display of sheer brutality, terrorists have unleashed a devastating strike aimed at the heart of Dhacca, targetting the iconic Nagar cinema hall. With motives much darker, their plan is to seize innocent lives as hostages and rig the entire hall with a ticking time bomb. Their demands are simple yet horrifying: the release of 13 notorious members of their terrorist faction, once captured by the MS unit. If the demands are not met within the next 5 hours, the hostages will suffer a devastating fate and the very soul of Dhacca will be torn apart by a catastrophic explosion. The stakes are high and the clock is ticking. 

Squad AI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d2b4cdbe71d8f044e520a762e09fd15aca0422da.jpg

The Squad AI introduces an ensemble of commandable companions that seamlessly integrate into the game's environment, enhancing solo gameplay. With a range of basic commands such as "stack up," "breach," "fall in," and "hold position," etc., players can direct their AI squad mates strategically, forming a new level of coordinated attacks. Excitingly, if the player meets an unfortunate fate, they will seamlessly transition to control one of the remaining squad mates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c87f15729a4cc0094e25e245a8b1547dcdbf5c60.gif

Taser
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/4719e5ce8aa1005ccf311fb83e11a64549570ed7.jpg

Prepare to wield the game's first non-lethal weapon: the Taser. This short-range device delivers an immobilizing shock, stunning targets without causing lethal harm. Exclusive to co-op gameplay, the Taser offers limited ammunition, requiring strategic usage. By using the Taser, players can accelerate the process of making NPCs compliant and persuade suspects to surrender, adding dimension to the mission strategy. Beware, as low-health individuals may succumb to its charge, resulting in unintended fatalities. This weapon can also be used by the squad AI members. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/07545e1cf5a4e01f26a026890c0e2a30d9dba97c.gif

Improved Animations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bbfa25e26769b402cbbd9b7a0ef8b8cbaa75f8fc.gif

To further refine the animation experience, we have separated inertia animations between the first-person and third-person perspectives. This ensures that players in first-person view experience reduced head shake movement, minimizing any potential discomfort. However, the proper look and feel of the animations will be present when viewed in third person. This will retain visual accuracy and authenticity in the third-person view. 
To learn more: Previous Steam News

NPC Character
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e60dd7626653b6161bf488ba88eb95c560008e81.gif

Story-related NPCs have been added to the game to introduce a new layer of immersion and narrative depth. Now, players will encounter intriguing characters that breathe life into each mission. For instance, the wife of a serial killer or the pharmacist who works in the very building you infiltrate. These NPCs are intended to add an extra level of realism and story to each mission. As we continue to enhance the game, more NPCs will be introduced in upcoming updates. 

Subtitles System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d4a31ebf9b9cc610a82c1f723d46cb7dd62bcc13.gif

Recognizing the importance of effective communication between players and suspects/NPCs, we have added subtitles to our game. This is to ensure that language barriers do not hinder gameplay experiences. Now, when suspects and NPCs speak in Bangla, players will have access to subtitles in English, enabling them to comprehend the dialogue and react accordingly. 

Further Optimization

We are pleased to announce notable optimizations in a number of areas of our game as part of our ongoing effort to offer the best gaming experience possible. With a focus on shooting mechanics, door interactions, and audio functionality, we have resolved key performance-related issues, ensuring reduced FPS spike and smoother gameplay. 
To learn more: Previous Steam News

Features Being Postponed


Unfortunately, some of the announced features are still a work in progress and will be added as soon as they are ready. Our current focus is on refining the base functionalities to ensure a polished and enjoyable experience for players.

Squad Career System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b9659e0d905dc1e37e1ac5b7e5ef89cc95f68d68.png

Although nearly ready, the squad career system is not available at this time. It is our priority to ensure that the Squad AI functions as a cohesive unit, responding effectively to player commands and making intelligent decisions. We believe it is crucial for players to have a seamless experience without losing squad members due to avoidable mistakes. The wait won't be long as after 2/3 iterations of the Squad AI with the upcoming patches, we aim to introduce the Squad career system as one of the patches. 

Attack dog
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0cb0038cc09c0fb54af023c673d239e44a33e5e6.gif

The development of the attack dog feature is still in progress, as we are dedicated to ensuring its functionality and presentation meet our high standards. Our goal is for the attack dog to seamlessly complement the squad AI. The squad AI does not have the ability to detect traps, therefore, our plan is to integrate the attack dog to assist in trap detection. This will allow you to assign squad AI members to defuse traps, making use of the dog's abilities. Additionally, the dog will aid in suspect detection, alerting you to suspicious activities such as specific routes taken or interactions with certain doors.

Features you might have missed!


In case you missed our previous patches, we are excited to highlight several noteworthy additions and improvements to the game. These include the introduction of a new handgun, the ability to switch between high and low ready positions, enhancements to suspect behavior, and visibility changes. 

Competitive Lighting Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/597dbfa71e71bf7be0a2dc68aa35ebc2a6a67cb6.gif

To enhance the storytelling and immersive experience of our maps, we have intentionally created darker environments that reflect the realistic atmosphere of the locations. However, we understand that prolonged PvP gameplay sessions may be challenging under these conditions. To counter this, we have introduced a separate lighting mode specifically for PvP, which brightens the surroundings for improved visibility and gameplay. However, if you are a fan of the regular lighting mode, rest assured as you can still opt for that in custom matches. 

Co-Op Suspect Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/8027c266b3f4884be19dba386a7c01a255b146ee.gif
Suspect Distress

Suspects are designed to experience distress levels that correspond to the intensity and pressure of the mission. In some cases, this heightened state may lead them to commit suicide. Payers have the opportunity to intervene and prevent such actions by shooting the weapon out of the suspect's hand, earning extra points in the process.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/f03d62a9e0d80111e45185dd746cc1c42f107e2a.gif
Suspect Able to throw

Suspects possess the ability to strategically employ defensive measures by throwing grenades, flares, and molotov cocktails to safeguard their positions and disrupt the player's progress. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7ff28da56cff2346fd141da2e70450e7a8c7c313.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/677985bb85d0b56205c324dfc0c4c2b1854fc008.gif
Various Suspect Reactions

Suspects react by stumbling to being shot in the leg, acknowledging the impact. In addition, they may taunt the player, attempting to intimidate and discourage them from advancing further in such a situation. 

Conclusion: 

We are thrilled to bring you these new additions and updates to Zero Hour, and we sincerely hope you enjoy them. Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the game and enhancing the overall experience. The development of the new map and squad AI has been a long and exciting journey, and we can't wait to hear your thoughts on them. Looking ahead, we have an exciting update in store for you, including the introduction of a flyable drone, the highly anticipated attack dog, new maps (including a school map), and various other improvements. We appreciate your unwavering support, which allows us to create the game we've always envisioned. Thank you for being part of this incredible journey.

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Thunderbolt Details
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c9b5a5df452797f41228f81125bacf586dc73b65.gif
Zero Hour's Operation Thunderbolt is here with exciting additions and significant optimizations that enhance your gaming experience. Prepare to trudge through a new map, engage with an AI squad, and wield the game's first non-lethal weapon. We've also fine-tuned shooting mechanics, improved door interactions, and enhanced audio functionality for smoother and more immersive gameplay. 
[hr][/hr]
Main Features:  

New Map: Show Time 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e75ae4207284a7b3d186ebfcfd3e05269ac5509a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d8436d84ba0d86d4616d7517181115d25c112950.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ee1e77708a11a90fe839d167bd8d9feef2e52f71.jpg

In a stunning display of sheer brutality, terrorists have unleashed a devastating strike aimed at the heart of Dhacca, targetting the iconic Nagar cinema hall. With motives much darker, their plan is to seize innocent lives as hostages and rig the entire hall with a ticking time bomb. Their demands are simple yet horrifying: the release of 13 notorious members of their terrorist faction, once captured by the MS unit. If the demands are not met within the next 5 hours, the hostages will suffer a devastating fate and the very soul of Dhaka will be torn apart by a catastrophic explosion. The stakes are high and the clock is ticking. 

Squad AI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d2b4cdbe71d8f044e520a762e09fd15aca0422da.jpg

The wait is almost over! To answer the prayers of players worldwide, the highly anticipated Squad AI feature has been added. Fuelled with an undying passion for immersive gameplay, this initial iteration of the Squad AI system will set the stage for future enhancements. 

The Squad AI introduces an ensemble of commandable companions that seamlessly integrate into the game's environment, enhancing solo gameplay. With a range of basic commands such as "stack up," "breach," "fall in," and "hold position," etc., players can direct their AI squad mates strategically, forming a new level of coordinated attacks. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c87f15729a4cc0094e25e245a8b1547dcdbf5c60.gif

One notable aspect of the Squad AI system is its modular design. We essentially create a new instance of the player, and that new player is controlled by an AI entity. This enables seamless synchronization of the squad with the main player. Any upgrades, abilities, or equipment acquired by the player will be automatically transferred to the AI squad mates. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/6a364ae91298371394b0cce9747fb74df96a5022.gif

This also implies that we may soon be able to offer offline PvP options, but we’ll cross that bridge when we get there. 

Besides executing commands, the AI squad members will sometimes engage in spontaneous conversations. These interactions will not only create an immersive atmosphere but also make the AI companions appear more lifelike, creating a deeper connection between players and their digital allies. 

To accommodate different play styles, players have the freedom to form a team of up to 9 members or go solo for each mission. This will allow players to tailor their experience according to their preference, whether they crave a lone wolf strategy or the companionship of a full squad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7b07376464ebd864685da140c6d7987de998ffc8.gif

The Squad AI system features a unique Squad Career system, designed to give each AI squad member a distinct personality and skill set. While players cannot customize the loadout of their AI companions, this limitation is compensated by preset loadouts tailored to individual personalities. This feature encourages players to experiment and strategize in diverse ways, utilizing each squad member’s unique abilities.

Taser
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/4719e5ce8aa1005ccf311fb83e11a64549570ed7.jpg

Get ready to wield a new weapon in your arsenal: the Taser. It represents the first non-lethal weapon introduced in the game. The Taser is designed to immobilize and incapacitate targets without causing any lethal harm. Emitting a strong electrical charge, it delivers a shock that stuns targets within its short-range reach. This non-lethal option provides players with a tactical alternative when facing suspects, creating an opportunity for more nuanced and strategic gameplay. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/07545e1cf5a4e01f26a026890c0e2a30d9dba97c.gif

The Taser is exclusive to the co-op gameplay. It is equipped with limited ammunition, thus,  players must consider when and how to best utilize this during gameplay. By using the Taser, players can accelerate the process of making NPCs compliant and persuade suspects to surrender, adding dimension to the mission strategy. Furthermore, squad AI members also have the ability to use the Taser.

While the Taser is designed to be non-lethal, in rare cases, players or suspects with low health may give in to the electrical charge, resulting in unintended fatalities. This calls for calculated decision-making and precise target selection when using the Taser. 

More Features 


Squad Career System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b9659e0d905dc1e37e1ac5b7e5ef89cc95f68d68.png

Prepare for an emotionally charged and immersive gaming experience with the new squad career system. To make the gameplay more realistic, we are introducing the concept of perma-death for the AI squad mates. Every mission is a high-stakes endeavor, where the lives of your digital companions hang on the line. If they fall in the line of duty during a mission, they will meet a permanent end—unless the player chooses to reset their career.  

To ensure that the loss of a fallen comrade does not impede your progress, players have the option to hire new squad AI teammates from the hiring menu. Here, the players can assess potential recruits' skills, preferred load-outs, and unique attributes before making the selection.  

To add more depth, the Squad Career system also introduces a dynamic skill progression for the AI squad mates. Through regular missions and successful completions, your squad members will gain experience, polishing their abilities and growing more proficient over time. Additionally, with future updates, we plan to infuse squad AI teammates with unique personality traits which will further differentiate each member. 

It is important to note that the Squad Career system is still a work in progress. Only a limited number of squad AIs can be hired at the time of the release of the update, however, we are looking forward to adding more soon.

It should also be noted that although we intend to include this feature in the upcoming update, unforeseen challenges may arise that could delay its release.

Improved Animations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bbfa25e26769b402cbbd9b7a0ef8b8cbaa75f8fc.gif

Say goodbye to robotic movements and hello to fluid motion with the introduction of improved locomotion animation. Through careful refinement, we have tried to create a more seamless and realistic representation of how characters traverse their environments. By injecting a sense of inertia, we have ensured that each step taken by players feels grounded and believable, enhancing the overall realism of the game.

To further refine the animation experience, we have separated inertia animations between the first-person and third-person perspectives. This ensures that players in first-person view experience reduced head shake movement, minimizing any potential discomfort. However, the proper look and feel of the animations will be present when viewed in third person. This will retain visual accuracy and authenticity in the third-person view. 

We have also added various new animations to further enrich the movement and actions of both suspects and players. These additional animations add depth to character interactions, heightening the realism and enhancing the overall visual appeal of the game. 

NPC Character
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e60dd7626653b6161bf488ba88eb95c560008e81.gif

To introduce a new layer of immersion and narrative depth, we have added story-related NPCs into the game. Now, players will encounter intriguing characters that breathe life into each mission. For instance, the wife of a serial killer or the pharmacist who works in the very building you infiltrate. These NPCs are intended to add an extra level of realism and story to each mission. As we continue to enhance the game, more NPCs will be introduced in upcoming updates. 

Subtitles System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d4a31ebf9b9cc610a82c1f723d46cb7dd62bcc13.gif

Recognizing the importance of effective communication between players and suspects/NPCs, we have added subtitles to our game. This is to ensure that language barriers do not hinder gameplay experiences. Now, when suspects and NPCs speak in Bangla, players will have access to subtitles in English, enabling them to comprehend the dialogue and react accordingly. 

Further Optimization

We are pleased to announce notable optimizations in a number of areas of our game as part of our ongoing effort to offer the best gaming experience possible. With a focus on shooting mechanics, door interactions, and audio functionality, we have resolved key performance-related issues, ensuring reduced FPS spike and smoother gameplay. 

Through thorough analysis, we identified a critical issue regarding weapon firing that was causing unnoticed garbage collection, leading to the accumulation of unnecessary resources over time. We have implemented fixes to prevent this issue from occurring. Additionally, we resolved internal engine log-related problems that were causing excessive CPU usage, resulting in a more efficient gameplay experience.

To further maximize efficiency, we have optimized the interaction system for doors to ensure less CPU usage. Recognizing that doors function as physical objects that require movement, we have implemented strategies to minimize the number of doors undergoing movement at one time whenever possible. We have also invested time and effort into optimizing suspect AI. By addressing issues that caused frame rate spikes, we intend to create a smoother and more consistent experience.

We understand that lighting plays an important role in creating immersive environments. However, it is also true that excessive GPU usage caused by active lights can impact overall performance. To create a balance between performance and visual quality, we have implemented advanced techniques to reduce the number of active lights at a time when they are not in the player's line of sight.

Development Log Video
We have also prepared a short video showcasing some of these changes.
[previewyoutube=U3CXvqMYI1o;full][/previewyoutube]
Conclusion: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ed36a944e6cfcea243075e820fe923dd6e4f56e6.jpg
The planned release date for this update is on 21st June 2023. Stay tuned as we will provide more news and updates for Operation Thunderbolt in detail soon. The highly anticipated attack dog feature is still in the works and will be released with our next update. The slight delay is due to our commitment to creating a natural-looking dog. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. 

Make sure you have not missed out on any of the new features that we have added with our recent patches. You will be able to check them out using the links below.

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Khan Manzil
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/23d0e6793831df9daca7c1490401bd1750b885c9.gif
Zero Hour’s Operation Khan Manzil consists of a new map, the addition of a 10-player CO-OP experience, new weapons, improved optimization, accessibility & more. This update focuses on content updates and quality improvements.
[hr][/hr]


Addition of a New Map
Khan Manzil
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/36e53e34eaaab87ac9612be706ef92f2c3d121f6.png

First up, we're thrilled to announce the addition of a brand new map - Khan Manzil. This two-storied building is packed with narrow corridors and rooms, offering a fresh challenge to players. With multiple entries and vents that you can throw grenades through, you'll have to strategize your attack like never before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bf926975720f29bb5481c3ffd630283e2879a3fc.png

The story involves a bomb situation. The Suspected location's name is Khan Mazil. A civilian called 911 spotting a person making a bomb on the boot of a car. The exact location of the vehicle is unknown so locate the bomb and expect armed hostiles around the area. There are suspicions about there being more bombs scattered around the city so bring in suspects and we will interrogate them for locations later. This is a race against time, we expect you to find the bomb before any damage is done.


New Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/628cbafbc5ac574442f0d0f2c140ab099f66c9d0.png

AKS-74U

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d303c57e1d023d92855cbe359378f5be09d6f4fb.gif


The AKS-74U is a shrunk-down AK-74 it's got an eight-and-a-half-inch barrel with a side folding stock. The chamber is in 5.45 by 39 caliber. AKS-74U offers the compactness and handiness of an SMG but is chambered for the standard 5.45x39mm rifle cartridge and took standard AK-74 magazines. It also gives its users more striking power than a pistol-caliber weapon.


HK UMP

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/4525bc0cb7aae9ae8567bfd192b4bfc2a3a8eb1e.gif


This is a significant departure from the MP5 mechanically. Instead of being roller-delayed blowback, this is just a simple blowback submachine gun. It does fire from a closed bolt. It's primarily a 9mm semi-automatic carbine, with the option to flip the switch and have full-auto if you really need it. And in that context, having a closed-bolt firing gun is definitely an advantage. It makes for, in a practical matter, a much more accurate first or single shot. the UMP does maintain that closed-bolt hammer-fired functionality. It retains a lot of the handling elements of the MP5. But instead of having a stamped sheet-metal receiver with a bunch of relatively complex milled parts, this is an extremely simple gun with a polymer receiver and a very blocky square bolt. 

New co-op experience
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/37de2790bed0efb20d4afdc0b7200681ff40e5f5.gif

CO-OP mode is now featuring 10-player CO-OP missions. You can now add up to 10 players to your squad and engage with a whole new combat experience in the field. The CO-OP menu has also been improved due to its new features and accessibility. 

New Features

Utility Slot 3
We've added two new utilities - Utility 3. This includes the Door Rammer and Medkit, offering new opportunities for both offense and defense. The Door Rammer allows you to make entry from any angle, and the Medkit will restore your HP when you're low on health.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d0007cbc2dd2e74b84c6e73563b6822340cfbaac.gif

Door rammer
In order to maintain control of a situation and ensure optimal safety, law enforcement personnel use stealth and surprise when breaching.  Tactical entry equipment is used by law enforcement practitioners, specifically, specialized teams such as special weapons and tactics (SWAT) or tactical entry teams, to gain access to restricted areas (e.g., barricaded entries, boarded buildings, and locked doors). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/90880a517166059ae0b05041de32bba4ba9f6fd6.gif

Med Kit
This kit combines a 12” Syringe with a SWAT-T tourniquet and a pack of H&H Medical’s Compressed Gauze into a single, easy-to-carry package. 
Note that you will not be able to use it while at full HP. For the SWAT team the med-kit will restore 20 HP, while for Terrorist team the med-kit will restore 10 HP.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/68b3062906486bcdc899d95c8578d1cb1b00d4d6.gif

Terror house texture rework
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/edfcf9126144c47d0763de08c796010596321068.gif

The map has been reworked to look more in line with our newer work. Just like all maps we have reworked, we have attempted to smoothen the edges of Terror House and bump up the texture quality to improve the overall believability and immersion. 


Miscellaneous  improvements
We've also made some miscellaneous changes, including improved animation syncing with weapons, improved lighting and brightness throughout some of the maps, and new animations for better visual cues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/8f186e1b083e624e8e3e31f6c272f5cf01833ee9.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c026191473a417142b76471aa7a50992c2698666.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d3c304346ae1b96f01f502be6b0048a68228e3a8.gif


Conclusion
We are trying to get up to speed again to provide content sooner like we used to in the past. We always hope to progress through smaller patches until the next major update. Thanks to the private testers team for testing out the builds with every internal update to ensure a more polished experience for the public release of the update. 

We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game.

[hr][/hr]

Addition of a New Map
Prison Break
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ba8b5fea48b1e870867d5f4ce0c0a5a097cabe08.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/fd53482f8db48a2e7bc0903781b8b775113d4723.png
 Only the co-op mission will have the top floor and the underground parking accessible. In PvP this map will be slightly smaller.
MS-Unit just received a call of a raid at the Danshiri Police Station. Since the Terrorist leader, Ahmed Al Zoori is held captive inside this station, we assume the terrorist’s motive is to break him out. MS-Unit are tasked to stop Ahmed Al Zoori from escaping and to eliminate all suspects.


Addition of Co-op TPP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/54217ff87829297da26f426ad781afc05d195de5.gif
This will only be accessible in co-op mode as an option. We wanted to bring a new perspective and experience for players and the game's mechanics. Of course, this won't change any fundamentals of the game. 


New SWAT Character Models
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0214797c8192f5bc8153df7dce6784765e0ee304.gif
The Swat Character models have been remodeled to achieve a more realistic look. In addition to that, animations have also been altered to have the character models look more smooth and organized instead of looking slightly unwary. 


Residential House Reworked
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3a399b0be793860c8316f9f67edce648c63db95a.gif
In our process of reworking the previous maps to make them look more inline with our newer work, we have attempted to smoothen the edges of Residential House and bump up the texture quality to improve the overall believability and immersion. We tried not changing the spaces and layouts of the original map to ensure it does not disrupt the already fun gameplay. Next map to receive a re-work is Terror House.


Hotel Trouble Lighting Reworked
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/8b58a27c9daef4e23211444752969df3270f84b0.gif
At the time of developing Hotel Trouble we did not have the proper tools and knowledge to bring the lighting we wanted. With time and effort we have found ways to get closer to that vision and so the ambient lights and GI have finally been implemented to the map.

Addition of Molotov
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bb1fe26a5cf14c67c1de7577a48821d62f010c56.gif
A new addition to the defender's utility collection, the molotov will help players threaten opponents from entering the room and buy them few more seconds to decide their next move.


Co-Op Suspect Suicide Vest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/8435f3875b5213e59fe5a94126c0d20501e86b39.gif
We have added Suicide vests as an option for suspects in various bomb appropriate missions. You will now see some suspects wearing bomb vests roaming in the map. These suspects will run towards you when you are spotted. You can still make them surrender by shooting their hand, however killing the suspect will initiate the count down to detonating their vest.


Hostage Gameplay Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0119a852464e57190912232e3744c221dcde2d27.gif
The hostage game mode was untouched for a long while and we are looking to focus on improving it based on user feedback. Hostages now stick very closely to the player to remove the tediousness of having to wait for them to move closer and disrupting overall gameplay. Along with them sticking close to you, the hostage icon will no longer appear when being interacted; meaning defenders will no longer be able to see the hostage location when attackers are extracting. These are just our initial attempts at fixing the issues, we plan on adding further improvements very soon.


Material Based Footsteps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/587437721d3c4e84e0bbb4163666a8f69867f920.gif
While we have made several attempts in the past to get material based footsteps into the game due to not being able to find a bandwidth friendly way of making this feature work. The feature is finally in the game but with a limited pool of surface types that we plan to expand with time.


Improved Loading Time even further

We reworked the internal data system to improve loading times. According to our tests, it has cut down the loading time further more than the previous update. This has fixed prolonged issues such as crashing, resulting in heavy memory usage or CPU heating. 


Conclusion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/4e5f1b2a5b44ec7496152f3f1a7c9ca1a81591e1.png
We are trying to get up to speed again to provide content sooner like we used to in the past. We always hope to progress through smaller patches until the next major update. Thanks to the private testers team for testing out the builds with every internal update to ensure a more polished experience for the public release of the update. 

We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game.

notes.title: Zero Hour | Major Update News
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/eef1308a06b163826e943d67ab751f973e9db9ae.jpg
Zero Hour’s next major update consists of a new map, attack dog(co-op), Molotov, gameplay tweaks & more. This update focuses on content updates and quality improvements. 
[hr][/hr]

Road Map 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e8462261437cf3b8aaab3e06cc924daad2f67263.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/79db0344df4ada6e23efefdac5c7abe538104016.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/6543db20825c7702c2a5263f572c9d4d9f195493.png
All dates noted are in a predicted schedule. A portion of the few announced features may come in parts earlier than scheduled, but we plan on completing them by the month announced.

[expand type=details]August 2022
- Attack dog featured
While the attack dog is very CO-OP oriented, we believe adding this feature will achieve a more rich and dynamic swat breach experience. Attack dogs will be used to detect various explosives to protect their handlers and personnel from danger and other crime scene evidence, along with more plans to be announced soon. 

September 2022
- Improving Game Modes
We will be improving the current game modes to improve the overall experience of each map and make it more fun and exciting, particularly the hostage extraction mode. 

September 2022 - April 2023
- CO-OP NPC/Story-Telling. 

November 2022
- New character models
The current placeholder Swat and Suspect models will be replaced with better-detailed characters while more accurately representing the story lore and more. With an added possibility of general character customization.

December 2022
- Game Audio Finalization
While we are satisfied with many of the game's audio, a lot still needs to be changed before we can say we are finalized. We are taking feedback from you guys to ensure we find a more accurate and immersive Audio Experience.

January 2023
- Optimize and Polish
- Total of 15 map content
- Total of 22 weapons and 13 utility varieties 
- Training ground usable workbench
- Releasing official Ost on steam store including various Zero Hour artwork
- More achievements, including CO-OP 

January 2023
- Mocap Featured
All existing animations will be replaced using mocap to bring a more accurate and immersive visual to each movement. This includes animations for the Swats, Suspects, and even the Hostage and Civilians. The current animations are hand-made, thus giving them a more cartoon-like look, and we aim to fix that.

January 2023
- Gameplay Overhaul and Finalization

February 2023
- Fixing all existing bugs
Declaring to fix the list of current major bugs, but these things take a long time when the recreate-ability of some bugs is rare or even unknown. 

- Co-Op Squad AI
We were expecting to add the Squad AI in the next few months; however, due to the delay in mocap equipment, we are unable to bring it to a more visually appealing state. We aim to have it complete by the end of February 2023. 

June 2023
- UI/UX Finalization

June 2023
- VFX/Lighting

August 2023
- Total of 20 map content
- Total of 25 weapons and 15 utility varieties 
- Re-evaluating the balancing of the overall game
- Finalizing more achievements, including CO-OP[/expand]


New Update Info
New Character Models and Minor Animation changes 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/5fd99330fda5aae3f9f506de9e74e1764cc2d1f1.png
The current placeholder Swat and Suspect models will be replaced with better-detailed characters while more accurately representing the story lore and more. With an added possibility of general character customization. New Attacker character models will be coming in the next update, while the new Defender character models will be out by November as noted in the Road Map. 

Attack Dog 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/cb06f9abeab698d5a7a277ea635d3e0c9ca57c7e.png
Attack dogs will be used to detect various explosives to protect their handlers and personnel from danger and other crime scene evidence, along with more plans to be announced soon. On release it will only be available in co-op and only the host of the session can bring it in. We plan to bring it to pvp once we find a more balanced approach.

Gameplay Touch Ups 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ef09edd0df80909752676e1aa23499072e1e52f5.gif
Fine-tuning and optimizing various aspects of the game such as gunplay and stamina for a better feel and quality of gameplay. We are redoing some of the animations temporarily (as our mocap is still not here) to improve the overall look and feel of the characters.  

New Map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ba8b5fea48b1e870867d5f4ce0c0a5a097cabe08.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/fd53482f8db48a2e7bc0903781b8b775113d4723.png
 Only the co-op mission will have the top floor and the underground parking accessible. In PvP this map will be slightly smaller.
MS-Unit just received a call of a raid at the Danshiri Police Station. Since the Terrorist leader, Ahmed Al Zoori is held captive inside this station, we assume the terrorist’s motive is to break him out. MS-Unit are tasked to stop Ahmed Al Zoori from escaping and to eliminate all suspects. A timer will indicate when all prison doors open leading to Ahmed Al Zoori running towards the exit. However, MS-Unit is ordered to capture him alive so making him surrender is the only option to complete the mission successfully. 

OST Release 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e948fe76a9dce79f4df6c4da103c7869dfe0f915.png
The original soundtrack from Zero Hour, featuring 20 official soundtracks (about 1 hour 8 mins) composed and mastered by Muhaimen Zia. All tracks are of the highest quality, each consisting of various Official Album Art. A PDF containing words from the artist, talking about each track will be available in the package. As an extra, you will receive Beta Music from the beta phase of Zero Hour. All tracks are available in WAV and MP3. 

Zero Hour Original Soundtrack will be available from 13th August

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1564000/

Conclusion

We apologize for the delay and lack of updates in the past few weeks. We hope to bring out quality content with our upcoming update sometime late August. 

We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game.

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Rat’s Den
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/99131a7ec2f2e49b5f057eca6a6f638397c45edf.jpg
Zero Hour’s Operation Rat’s Den consists of a new map, the addition of CO-OP puzzles, improved loading times light optimizations & more. This update focuses on content updates and quality improvements. 
[hr][/hr]

New Map

Rat’s Den
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3f459afa9f175d6837ea899e85bb3e81472386d8.jpg
‘Through an interrogation from the terrorists we took in, we have news about a suspicious building located on the outskirts of Sylhet. We received evidence of suspects abducting locals who have been reported missing. We believe they are all ending up in this building here. This base is run by their leader Jubayer Kashem, the brother of Abdul Kashem who we captured in Operation Breaking Meth. He seems to be continuing his family legacy, and along with that, he’s taking in locals subjecting them to forced labor. The convict also mentioned a hideout hidden somewhere in the AO. The objective is to infiltrate the premises, bring in Jubayer Kashem and locate if there are any possible traces leading to a hideout. Be sure to go through the building with your eyes peeled.’


Addition of Co-op Puzzle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/254c803d03c6e22a09aec924304e854a9cb27cac.gif

We plan to add various puzzle-based objectives in CO-OP, requiring the players to find and solve codes to enter secret locations to complete the mission. This will further add to the experience with an investigating tone of immersion. For this release, we will only include them in Rat’s den. Puzzles for other maps will be added in the future. 


Improved Loading Time


We reworked the internal data system to improve loading times. According to our tests, it has cut down the loading time by 1/3. This has fixed prolonged issues such as crashing resulting in heavy memory usage or CPU heating. 

Lights Optimization


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0ace64ad8327844ece0d551507ba26df51a28b9e.gif

We used new lighting techniques which got rid of unnecessary rendering time and additions of Realtime GI which will allow the lighting of every scene to reflect the environment in a more realistic & immersive fashion. This is essentially useful for Lights that change slowly and have a significant visual impact on the Scene, such as a slowly pulsating light in a closed corridor.


Leaderboard Reset

The matchpoint leaderboard has been reset to give more accurate readings and scores to players. The issue where players receive inaccurate match points in online matches has been resolved so the points players earn are precise and fair for everyone. 

After every operation, we will have a Leaderboard Reset where the top three players will be displayed as milestones. This should push players to be at the top of the leaderboard.


Misc Improvements
These improvements contain better Ambient Occlusion, AI Behavior Improvements, and Environmental SFX and a New CO-OP UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/04f9101505b8faf1a3b1f6a99e788f902d13f032.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1a3bfb80356304ac632d79a31b5c74798ff00cb3.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/45e0de762ae32d43299036cd0c3a4b5888e1cdf4.gif

Conclusion

Many new exciting features such as Squad AI and Motion Capture are still on the way along with more updates which we will announce soon. We always hope to progress through smaller patches until the next major update. Thanks to the private testers team for testing out the builds with every internal update to ensure a more polished experience for the public release of the update. 

We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game.

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Red Wedding
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/dc59e86b6e7d9f13b861d88e5b106861b5e37747.jpg
Zero Hour's latest update of 5 new weapons, one new map, Optimizations, and other miscellaneous improvements. This update primarily consists of content updates, but more 'Quality Of Life' improvements are still on the way. 
[hr][/hr]

New Map

Red Wedding
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c9d9f6b2f0d1274b49c6e55f77dcc3c7c74c7525.gif
The Major General’s daughter Taniya was to be married to Mashrub on the 4th of January but hell broke loose as Terrorists attacked the venue during the ceremony. Local Officials state at least 40 people have been killed and 15 wounded. If the terrorists manage to capture Taniya, they will use her as leverage to get what they want from the Major. The MS-Unit has been dispatched to the scene with the area in strict lockdown. The venue has already been taken over by terrorists, along with civilians still inside. There are fears the number of dead could rise. 


Five New Weapons

SKS: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e21b84bdc2bc30319a216de4f0dae395d7a4d3ef.jpg
Sat right between the distinguished old bolt action Mosin Nagant and the historic AK-47 platform, which dominated for decades. For this reason, the SKS is like the middle child everyone forgot. The SKS-45 is a homely, though robust, rifle. Its metalwork and stock may be crude, but it has proven to be a remarkably reliable rifle, as are most Soviet-made guns. The rifle's lightweight and open style iron sights made acquiring a target easy at even 200 meters. This is available for Terrorists.

Honey Badger: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7a3be138690f8dee227d5ce86e49478c4931ad07.jpg
The honey badger was created at the request of an elite U.S special operations group looking to replace their mp5 SDS with an upgraded platform. Two of the main requirements included the ability to shoot a rifle caliber round while maintaining low visibility, and of course, it needed to retain a high level of suppression. This is available for Counter-Terrorists.

MK12: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/18aeeec68886c2eeb189ba6a6474a9a290db7d11.png
The  Mk12 was built for the U.S army to make a smaller, reliable gun and more versatile. The reason is they need something to blend better in urban environments. One of the commonalities of all mark 8 across mark 12's is an 18-inch barrel so that it's long enough to be ballistically effective but short enough to be portable. This is available for the Counter-Terrorists. 

CZP10C: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b6e6e2ab9fb22e99957c3c99fe5dcbae41ba9ef7.png
The P10C is a polymer-framed striker-fired handgun. It came to market in 2017 for personal defense, and the military introduced this handgun to be a direct competitor of the G-19. This is available for both Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists. 

FN FAL: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3bfc6c3a07394257e12947431030bf7e97efcc18.jpg
The FAL or, to give its full name, the 'Fusil Automatique Léger', is a battle rifle characterized by its selective-fire ability and chambering for a full-powered rifle cartridge. By modern standards, the FAL is a hefty weapon. Modern assault rifles fire smaller cartridges and make extensive use of polymers to reduce weight while the FAL is a full-size rifle of entire steel construction. This is available for Terrorists.


More Features 

Geforce Now Anti-Cheat Issue
We are aware of the issues players face using Geforce Now due to anti-cheat installation being a requirement for Quick-match. Everything from our side has been fixed, we are just waiting for Geforce Now to enable the settings.

Other Improvements:
We have optimized all of the maps in-game and added a skip button for the selection phase in CO-OP along with a longer phase duration. 


Features not added yet

Mocap Equipments
The Mocap Equipments is being delayed due to the unavoidable circumstance. The equipment will help make better and more grounded TPS (Third Person Shooter) animations and further add to our future content experiences. We are very excited for the Mocap equipments to arrive and work with it for Zero Hour.

Updating Network Structure
We haven't gone through with updating the network structure yet, but it will be updated soon with the following few updates. What this will do is give you the best experience with online gameplay. We expect better service and connectivity compared to the prior network structure. It would also further improve our security for anti-cheat detection. This may lead to the removal of unused or unpopular regions to compensate for the more active regions.

More Civillian Models
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1c83e3a01a232ff308b0d4db00001102057a0c97.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0e80ac934ea85cdff342a7c50cc864c7f37ccf8d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/417799ae61a1ff80afcf6dc2d698ff42d2b7b301.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3f498eb0a38bbd002aff876ff04075e022f0b83e.png

We have made several new civilian character models which we will add once all the animations are ready. We will soon start implementing the characters into our CO-OP experience which would help add immersion and difficulty to the game. 


Conclusion

Many new exciting features such as Squad AI are still on the way along with more updates which we will announce soon. We always hope to progress through smaller patches until the next major update. Thanks to the private testers team for testing out the builds with every internal update to ensure a more polished experience for the public release of the update. 

We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game.

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Red Wedding Details
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/cd89702399a0ad145652736742ac8d2662934b49.jpg
Zero Hour’s Operation Red Wedding consists of 5 new weapons, 1 new map and miscellaneous improvements. We are also bringing improvements in Network Structure and setting up Mocap equipments. This update primarily consists of content updates but more 'Quality Of Life' improvements are still on the way. 
[hr][/hr]
Main Features: 

Five New Weapons

SKS: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e21b84bdc2bc30319a216de4f0dae395d7a4d3ef.jpg
Sat right in between the distinguished old bolt action Mosin Nagant and the historic AK-47 platform, which dominated for decades, for this reason, the SKS is like the middle child everyone forgot. The SKS-45 is a homely, though robust, rifle. Its metalwork and stock may be crude, but it has proven to be a remarkably reliable rifle, as are most Soviet-made guns. The rifle's lightweight and open style iron sights made acquiring a target easy at even 200 meters. This is available for Terrorists.

Honey Badger: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7a3be138690f8dee227d5ce86e49478c4931ad07.jpg
The honey badger was created at the request of an elite U.S special operations group looking to replace their mp5 SDS with an upgraded platform. Two of the main requirements included the ability to shoot a rifle caliber round while maintaining low visibility, and of course, it needed to retain a high level of suppression. This is available for Counter-Terrorists.

MK12: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/18aeeec68886c2eeb189ba6a6474a9a290db7d11.png
The  Mk12 was built for the U.S army to make a smaller, reliable gun and more versatile. The reason is they need something to blend better in urban environments. One of the commonalities of all mark 8 across mark 12's is an 18-inch barrel so that it's long enough to be ballistically effective but short enough to be portable. This is available for the Counter-Terrorists. 

CZP10C: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b6e6e2ab9fb22e99957c3c99fe5dcbae41ba9ef7.png
The P10C is a polymer-framed striker-fired handgun. It came to market in 2017 for personal defense, and the military actually introduced this handgun to be a direct competitor of the G-19. This is available for both Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists. 

FN FAL: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3bfc6c3a07394257e12947431030bf7e97efcc18.jpg
The FAL - or, to give its full name, the 'Fusil Automatique Léger', is a battle rifle characterized by its selective-fire ability and chambering for a full-powered rifle cartridge. By modern standards, the FAL is a hefty weapon - modern assault rifles fire smaller cartridges and make extensive use of polymers to reduce weight - while the FAL is a full-size rifle of entire steel construction. This is available for Terrorists.


New Map

Red Wedding 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c9d9f6b2f0d1274b49c6e55f77dcc3c7c74c7525.gif
The Major General’s daughter Taniya was to be married to Mashrub on the 4th of January but hell broke loose as Terrorists attacked the venue during the ceremony. Local Officials state at least 40 people have been killed and 15 wounded. If the terrorists manage to capture Taniya, they will use her as leverage to get what they want from the Major. The MS-Unit has been dispatched to the scene with the area in strict lockdown. The venue has already been taken over by terrorists along with civilians still inside. There are fears the number of dead could rise. 

More Features 


Overhauled Movement Animation
We are experimenting with various methods to improve the overall fps movement animations to counter the feel of stuttered animation transitions (This overhaul is set to change with all current animations in the game thus far.)

Updating Network Structure
We are working together with Photon Networks to give you the best experience with online gameplay. We expect better service and connectivity compared to the prior network structure. This would further improve our security for anti cheat detection. This may lead to removal of unused or unpopular regions to compensate for the more active regions.

Geforce Now Anti-Cheat Issue
We are aware of the issues being faced by players using Geforce Now due to anti-cheat installation being a requirement for Quick-match. Rest assured with this update we will have that fixed.

Upcoming In Later Updates 

Squad AI Progress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/294a14db35bed152585658619877e2183d44b652.gif
 Dynamic AI stacking up behind doorway.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/41d5c27cbc9e19cf8aae05212b7ecf73a6deb463.gif
 Dynamic AI breach in.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/de62a84cf0ec4c96c21b00403c43e47ac18c659a.gif
 AI follow on command.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/8e679c9a1790c60833ac6b538ae7c6657e19e662.gif
 AI move to position while assigned target.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b1ae49f155c11240badf555ae2bf7dec51596fd0.gif
 AI Dynamic move to position with formation.

We have made good progress working with Squad AIs with the basic functionality added, such as
Stacking up, breaching preparation, covering, or following when ordered to do so.  More features are yet to be done, and more information will be out with later updates. 

The idea is to create a dynamic system that wont require predefining anything for the AIs in existing or new maps.

Mocap Equipments
We are setting up our own Mocap Studio which we plan to use to make better and more grounded TPS animations and further add to our future content experiences.

The planned release date for this update is in 7th March 2022. We have more news and updates for Operation Red Wedding which we will provide in detail soon so stay tuned.  We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game.

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update Now Available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/911d253b7eb14a6e25e355d8ede9f0c1e4c56595.jpg
Zero Hour's first Quality Of Life Updates include a new training ground, implementation of Denuvo Anti-Cheat, and Miscellaneous improvements. The next Major Update consisting of a new Operation is still in progress, and we hope to deliver that very soon. 

[hr][/hr]
New Training Ground  

The new Training Ground is now much more extensive than its precedent form. The latest additions to the Training Ground include Tutorials and Squad Based Training. 

Tutorials (First Iteration): The tutorials will help you better understand the fundamentals of gameplay and the way you should play it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/8129f5673bfbb0736896b8e9edb9e2e4cce021ac.gif

Squad Based Training: Now, you will be able to bring your teammates with you inside the training ground. You can run the Killhouse and play the tutorials together as a Squad, ensuring better teamwork before heading on to your missions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0e65b45dd3ff4feaf07d06ad8fadbd7e06590c26.gif

Denuvo Anti-Cheat Update 

The Denuvo Anti-Cheat is now implemented within the game. It is required when you play Quick Match but is optional for Custom Match and will not affect CO-OP mode and Training Ground. 

To clear any confusion, we added a FAQ for players who has any questions:

When does the anti-cheat install?
When Quick-match multiplayer is accessed 

Does it start with my computer? 
No, starts and stops with the game 

Will it make the game slower? 
No, we did extensive profiling and found no differences 

Can I remove it?
Yes, uninstall it from add/remove program files any time

This implementation only includes Denuvo Anti-Cheat, so your performance should remain unaffected.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/88fbcb6fda3ef98d34f05b022cc032dd85f1990a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0edc8a5f181a3bcbd167789e99c223f4ad4352c4.gif

Miscellaneous 

Hit Reg Improvements

We have received many complaints about our hit reg and overlooked many things. The player body collider shape has improved to match its visuals better. The hit reg was unusual because limbs would block the bullets. For example, your hands would only take the hit and not allow penetration to hit other areas such as the chest. This issue is now fixed. While the damage is unaffected, kill time will be significantly improved. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/4bb6a49c4dbaf6659a9a8fe67c072b4d2d577a88.gif

Optimization

We worked on smoother animation transitions since some animations have been abrupt or unpolished. Along with that, we worked on general improvements involved in gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/137ae3944c3e79bd5ede8524db1672b82fbc6616.gif

Camera Shake

To add to the authenticity for a better impact, such as grenades exploding or kicking a door down, we added a camera shake to further add to the experience. We did this to increase the visual effect of using explosives. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/be341df307fad3d19371ed875314b37f79eeb001.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/31406dfb32e6940a16fb84fbc441ec8152d41b01.gif

notes.title: Zero Hour | Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1236d013aba3f6a3b1bf14378b0532164032dce9.jpg
We have been working hard on implementing 'Quality Of Life' improvements and things like this take-up a lot of research and feedback we received throughout the year. We have been getting responses about how we only provide content and very few quality related updates, so we are changing that. That is why we are writing this announcement. We will give more information with updates very soon. Please note, This is an update which will be coming out in multiple patches. 

 When we will be adding the Quality of Life updates, we’ll announce the update coming in December/January soon, which will consist of the next major operation.  

[hr][/hr]
Features Added Thus Far

Server Browser
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b42308ca4b7f429b5df4cc4b5823e4b75310db1b.gif

The Server Browser has helped massively with improved matchmaking. Now, you're finally getting that ability to play with randoms or specific players. 

Reporting Bugs and players
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/04dacc157e67282dd9290547378ad8baeefd56a2.gif

We added a feature for reporting players and bugs where players don't have to manually send reports using discord anymore. This is out as our first iteration and is something that will improve over time. We also have plans to implement a report bug system and a possible replay system and possibly make it public where you can share your replays with others. 

Planned Updates

Anti-cheat
This is something we’ve been researching since the beginning. Through this, we have found that the Denuvo Anti-cheat would best cater to our needs. Their quality and services are beneficial to the game greatly and will make the players have a much better online experience in Zero Hour. The Anti-Cheat update will be coming out in the next upcoming patches. We will be releasing more information soon.

To clear any confusion, we added a FAQ for players who has any questions:

When does the anti-cheat install?
When Quick-match multiplayer is accessed 

Does it start with my computer? 
No, starts and stops with the game 

Will it make the game slower? 
No, we did extensive profiling and found no differences 

Can I remove it?
Yes, uninstall it from add/remove program files any time
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/6918a2af34c28e407f5f58a53e3894c97e508142.png

Polishing Gameplay
This could be an improvement from working on animations to smoother movement and better control to fixing bugs that stayed in the beginning. We plan on fixing these issues in the next update. 

New and improved Training Ground
One of the biggest elements we lack now is the ability to teach new players the Important fundamentals of gameplay before they get in the match. This is why we are working on a whole new training ground with a new kill-house and a whole new tutorial section.  We also have plans on making this squad-based where you can get in with your fellow teammates, giving this ability to players will give them benefits if they play in the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3956dcef657646e8c2dae551df9ea7fa3f059147.png

Next Operation: 
In our next operation, we have plans to add squad AI where players can have AI teammates (This is still in the research phase and we will soon update on this feature in later announcements), including new maps, guns, etc. Some of the new weapons planned are:

notes.title: Operation Meghna Now Available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1236d013aba3f6a3b1bf14378b0532164032dce9.jpg
Zero Hour's Operation Meghna consists of two new maps, weapons, features and bug fixes. It brings in new features such as Smoke Grenade, Tinnitus, gore & much more. We have focused on bringing in new visuals for players and other significant improvements.
[hr][/hr]

Two New Maps

Ferry
A Ferry Launch is a mode of water transport popularly used in Bangladesh. The Ferry Launch by the name of "M.V Meghna" has been rigged with a bomb by the terrorist organization wreaking havoc. While the vessel was on it's way to Ochinpur ( ~ Location ) someone reported the Ferry Launch has been hijacked. As there was no other approach, the MS - Unit was instructed to take on the operation in the middle of the river, Meghna.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c314ff69d4266e44852910abde7d0d0df2ae1b18.png

Abandoned Hospital
A viral video released by the terrorist group shook the nation on July 3rd. Where it showed the terrorists had the ambassador of the Asian Embassy abducted 2 days ago. The terrorists wanted their philosophical leader, Ahmed Al Zoori ( ~ Captured in Paradise City ), to be released from jail in exchange of the ambassadors life. The intelligence unit used the IP address associated with the video and tracked down the location to be an abandoned hospital near Tangail. The MS Unit was instructed to take on the operation. A lot was at stake as the demise of the ambassador may change the geopolitical scene of the region for good. When the MS Unit went in, the prime minister along with her national security team were in a situation room, receiving live updates from Operation Night Owl.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/243643632f1db22dc84660dfbedb3f63edf1d951.png

Four New Weapons:
To improve our pool of weapons and their accuracy to real life usage we added 4 new weapons; Sawed Off ( T-Side ), AS Val ( T-Side ), PP-19 Bizon ( T-Side ) & Five Seven ( CT-Side ). We switched the MP7 to the CT side and Uzi to be available exclusively on the T side while Glock will be available in both sides.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c1d48b7449dc02d2b771438e64c694c64426586c.gif

Feature Highlights


The New Weapon Audio
With Operation Meghna, we prioritized the improvement for weapon audio. In the making, we took many feedback from you guys to push emotion and tension into these gun sounds. We tried to make them punchy, satisfying and realistic. The gun sounds will also react to it's environment such as variations for shooting from outside or inside a building and even on different floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e3db8484b7c645b520b4630c64c73113f9ef71ef.gif

Cutscene Details
The cutscenes provide an in depth look at what’s happening at each mission. It provides a progressive storyline with the protagonist and what’s happening in the scene. We are going for an aesthetic and informative cutscene with many cutscenes being an abstract form of Art.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/4ea969742162f4d2c26a32c8599759a668d13ac5.gif

The cutscenes were managed to achieve the minimalistic design we were aiming for. It provides the necessary aspects to get the players in the mood for certain situations with it's own abstract form of Art.

Improved Gore 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/f68db76c5bfe7224054be75ea11ea10ebb4dd2e5.gif
We enhanced the gore in Zero Hour where the player models will have a more realistic shot wound. This was done to add to it's realistic factor but it's certainly an option that can be turned off in the settings menu. 

Tinnitus Effect 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/110c6ea7a1668b97ae5033e8407291c2d3efad00.gif
In addition to our new gun sounds coming into place, we also added a tinnitus effect where as the player will experience a slight ringing in their ear when they pull the trigger for a significant amount of time. The effect on the counter terrorist side will be more subtle than the terrorist side. 

Smoke grenade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/398f9b5201d5a8fd6ea10a8d02b52267d6ffdeac.gif
We added a smoke grenade where players can deploy a smoke screen to disable enemy sight. This will allow you to gain cover, rearrange formation and commence an attack from another direction. The smoke grenade will only be available for the Counter Terrorist side. 

Skill Based Match Making 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7c5bfa238f8b7f9f87d4575e8582ccca65908f1e.gif
Zero Hour will now carry out skill based matchmaking in Quick Match mode. We implemented a penalty for leaving a match which will result in -2000 MMR.  Steam Guard has also been added therefore you now have the choice to only queue with other verified steam users. This will be available as an option in the main menu. 

Reporting Dead Bodies in PvP
Since we are reworking the kill feed for Operation Meghna, we added a feature in PvP where you or your team will need to report in if you kill anyone from the enemy team to let your squad know the enemy is down. You will still receive a report automatically if your team mate is killed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/5795460eb4fdc400b37d1ad40a3778455349cede.gif

However, this is different in CO-OP where if your team mate is down, you will need to report it so the squad will be informed. 

New Inventory System
With the addition of a whole new inventory system we are trying to give the players the control over how they want to deal with situations as such; Letting you take either of the primary or secondary weapons along with possible utilities. This will also fix the involuntary weapon pick ups when interacting with other objects such as doors. The inventory system also has the feature to transfer ammo from one magazine to another compatible magazine, allowing you to refill unfinished mags.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/6deea334b93686542f56043be86a0ef954897464.gif


Weapon Stats
Weapon Statistics will now show up if you hover over a weapon in our weapons tab, giving you a information on how the gun performs. The tab shows the Weight, Recoil and Damage of the selected weapon. It also provides the difference between the selected weapon and the weapon you are hovering over. Including description of all the utilities and gadgets available in Zero Hour. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d86db6afef85d921b8ab8210b6a412efb3dd44b4.gif

Canted ADS
If you use a laser attachment that is visible to the naked eye, using ADS will be different. With this new system, using the normal laser and toggling it on will enable canted ADS similar to when you ADS with NVGs On. (Note if you do it while already in ADS, it will remain in that pose until you are out). Toggling it off will allow you to ADS through the sights again.



Conclusion: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/60f98ad1f225f73b74a06540bf1b6ad3048f1c32.jpg
 Some of the promised features have been delayed once again due to strict covid lockdown during our development period. We hope to make more progress through smaller patches till the next major update. Special Thanks to DemiMark for helping the SFX Artist with the weapon sounds. Thanks to the private testers team for testing out the builds with every internal update to ensure a more polished experience for the public release of the update.

Check out the 1 year anniversary trailer to find out more.

Abandoned Hospital:
This map is exactly how it sounds. It gives off a creepy eerie vibe with a lot of tight corridors. The walls and floors are old and lights flicker from time to time. The map has a decent amount of rooms with big hallways so you will find multiple ways you can engage in combat. 

Our good friend 'Scott Hotrod' uploaded a video showcasing a preview of the map. Check it out!
[previewyoutube=uys31Zgbae0;full][/previewyoutube]

The cutscenes provide an in depth look at what’s happening at each mission. It provides a progressive storyline with the protagonist and what’s happening in the scene. We are going for a aesthetic and informative cutscene with many cutscenes being an abstract form of Art.

It also provides the difference between the gun your holding and the gun you are hovering over. Including description of all the utilities and gadgets available in Zero Hour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7c5bfa238f8b7f9f87d4575e8582ccca65908f1e.gif

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Meghna Details
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d96a6237e5acefded0d67aab0c7101e806ae4ea8.jpg
Zero Hour's Operation Meghna consists of a lot of overhauls, 2 new maps, several new features and bug fixes. With this update, we are focusing on the quality of sound and gameplay. 
[hr][/hr]
Part Of So Many Lives
Hello everyone! We really want to thank the community and appreciate all the love and support you keep giving us. We understand we are a part of a lot of people's lives and we appreciate that more than anything and nevertheless, plan to keep delivering. Zero Hour has recently reached above 2,000 players after our last update and for that, we are so grateful. Thank you for being supportive in our direction for the game. We have more content on the way and we want to make the next update even bigger.

Once again, we really appreciate the love and support we’re getting from Zero Hour and we certainly can’t thank the community enough. The community has brought us so much joy in developing the game further, so we will always be motivated to bring Zero Hour to the level where everyone will be able to undergo an ultimate SWAT experience.

- Zero Hour Dev Team 

[hr][/hr]

Two New Maps: We are working on two new maps to bring with Operation Meghna; Ferry Launch & Abandoned Hospital. Both maps will be available as PvP & Co-op experiences. 

1.) Ferry Launch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7a1df67142d17f42e4d4fed742e8e149084084c1.jpg
 Please note, the picture shown is conceptual and will not be the final product of the map.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7bd042369e280442fa8fb7cb387836201d69f276.png
 Launch visual planning.
A Ferry Launch is a mode of water transport popularly used in Bangladesh. The Ferry Launch by the name of "M.V Meghna" has been rigged with a bomb by the terrorist organization wreaking havoc. While the vessel was on it's way to Ochinpur ( ~ Location ) someone reported the Ferry Launch has been hijacked. As there was no other approach, the MS - Unit was instructed to take on the operation in the middle of the river , Meghna.

2.) Abandoned Hospital

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/62f6ef102aa6fb62f822902b7561478015e3fd60.png
 Please note, the picture shown is conceptual and will not be the final product of the map.
A viral video released by the terrorist group shook the nation on July 3rd. Where it showed the terrorists had the ambassador of the Asian Embassy abducted 2 days ago. The terrorists wanted their philosophical leader, Ahmed Al Zoori ( ~ Captured in Paradise City ), to be released from jail in exchange of the ambassadors life. The intelligence unit used the IP address associated with the video and tracked down the location to be an abandoned hospital near Tangail. The MS Unit was instructed to take on the operation. A lot was at stake as the demise of the ambassador may change the geopolitical scene of the region for good. When the MS Unit went in, the prime minister along with her national security team were in a situation room, receiving live updates from Operation Night Owl.

Four New Weapons:  A lot of content is to be expected with the Operation Meghna update specially in regards to weapons. To improve our pool of weapons and their accuracy to real life usage we are working to add 4 new weapons; Sawed Off ( T-Side ), AS Val ( T-Side ), PP-19 Bizon ( T-Side ) & Five Seven ( CT-Side ). We will also be switching the MP7 to the CT side and Uzi to be available exclusively on the T side while Glock will be available in both sides.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bc374ede961a2e6c2a8ace20104c02bc23129d3d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/047555c28a584cfe57be74c4bb04a7c6831ba0da.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c5ab3cab4b7b6c40c37125df1687dca5f6c8f444.png
 Progress on AS Val model so far by one of our weapon artists 

1.) More Attachments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ec030cfb7a82971bdc5ffb78c292c0fd0208f2d0.gif
We have plans to increase the range of attachments available for every weapon. We have recently just added Pressure pad options in the Internal testing build (as shown in the GIF) with which players can assign auto toggle for IR/laser sights and flashlights. We plan to soon add grips & stocks as available options for some of the weapons.

2.) Correcting Realism Aspects
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/9eaff5754838831aaafdc3310b90bac05be0b5ef.gif
We are reworking some of the things to further help bring the realistic aspects to the attachments. The closest thing to note will be being able to see the IR sight point with out NVGs equipped. This will no longer be available with Operation Meghna and you will only be able to see IR laser when NVGs are equipped. However, there will also be options to use normal laser sights to be able to see without NVGs equipped.

Sounds Overhaul & Finalization: We are aware that sound is one of the aspects of the game we fall weak with Zero Hour. This time with Operation Meghna we are focusing on overhauling the weapon sounds and how they work. Having different states of shooting SFXs and having them work together to compose the sound based on location ( Single fire, Multiple fire, Tail fire ~ Note the current live version only has 1 single fire(+Above, + Below) SFX per weapon, that plays with each bullets fired ). Apart from adding those states we are also adding distance variation and indoor/outdoor variations to further enhance the way each weapon sounds based on the surrounding. We also have plans to add material based footsteps with this update. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/a8589a91051738628274d39f26a8a4c5cb07abe0.gif
 This time around we are working together with professionals to add further quality improvements to each SFX. More information on this will be revealed with later dev log

Co-op Cutscenes & voices: We plan to make co-op experience more premium and exciting and so with the help of cutscenes we aim to bring the players closer to the situations in hand. The cutscenes will help further explain the objectives and will work as a briefing to make players understand what's at stake. We also plan on retaking all voice lines in the game by professionals and also adding voice commands in game for people without mics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b8a6b0e0a4a698c37b1ff0d498cb52383bc62671.gif
 The cutscenes will play while you are loading the map with a short narration accompanying it and players will be able to skip it if they want to

The Removal of Kill feed: We plan to remove kill feed and make it more interactive similar to the swat games where you had to press a button after getting close to the affected suspect to report to TOC. After doing so your team will be notified about you killing someone. This should probably make combat more intense and not knowing if the suspect is dead adds on to that experience. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1082926957acfd1f97edeb6a3b2957c7a2ca5180.gif

The Ability to Shootout lights: This is a highly requested feature and we finally have plans to have it in the game. Shooting out lights will play a big impact in how the game is played and will add a whole new dynamic to each playthrough. To keep things balanced, shooting out lights will not be made as effective as a power cut-out meaning if all the lights in a room were shot out it will be dark however it wont be as dark as it could have been with full power out. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/9bb1b1850e5a6e265a246d22dee19dbdd5ed52db.gif
 The feature is still work in progress and more will be announced in later dev logs 

 Addition of an Inventory System: Taking weapons from other players at the moment is a pretty basic system and only allows you to pick up the primary weapon from another player. With the addition of a whole new inventory system we are trying to give the players the control over how they want to deal with situations as such; Letting you take either of the primary or secondary weapons along with possible utilities. This also has the possibility to change the dynamics of the round depending on how well equipped you remain. This will also fix the involuntary weapon pick ups when interacting with other objects such as doors. The inventory system will also have the feature to transfer ammo from one magazine to another compatible magazine, allowing you to refill unfinished mags.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/f026ffbea07282b0129523b9aea81464d5cf57f7.png
 The following is still a conceptual look and may change before the Operation Meghna update

Limiting Weapons & Utilities in Both Sides
Resource Management is also getting a rework and will be made that both Weapons and Utilities are limited resources for both sides in order to balance the upcoming weapons and utilities.

AI Improvements & More: There are a lot of features still missing from the suspect AIs in terms of their behaviors and reactions. Along with already promised features such as planning on table or interacting with environment still not in yet, we have plans to add and improve even further with the animations. Our character artist is working with the hostage models and civilian models ( for future civilian AIs roaming the map ). Along with the hostages getting their own unique models we are also working on making animations for them individually to add to their various personalities.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d4d5abae277c6bc15356ee9d832fc91cb4bf094d.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c5b055c365d1629774a71ace2735386f3e71cbb3.gif
